annotations.keyFindings: Five or more retailers within 800 metres went with higher odds of current smoking (odds ratio 1.31) after adjustment for school socioeconomic status and remoteness; no dose-response between one and four retailers.
annotations.limitations: Cross-sectional; 2017 data before licensing in this state.
annotations.notes: Closest design to the planned analysis.

annotations.keyFindings: Three or more retailers within 800 metres went with higher odds of current vaping in 2023 (odds ratio 1.22) but not clearly in 2021; adjustment for school socioeconomic status reduced both by about a third.
annotations.limitations: Vape-only retailers not licensed or counted.

annotations.keyFindings: A strong unadjusted association (odds ratio 1.62) fell to 1.09 with an interval including 1 after adjustment for neighbourhood deprivation.
annotations.limitations: Three cities only; deprivation measured by area.
annotations.notes: Conflicts with the state multilevel study; deprivation modelling decides the answer.

annotations.keyFindings: An 800 metre road network buffer best matched students' walking routes; one school in five had no retailer within 800 metres.
annotations.notes: Defines the exposure and the zero category.

annotations.keyFindings: Of students who bought their own product, 18 percent reported buying near school; younger students more often obtained products from friends or siblings.
annotations.notes: Limits how much a school buffer can explain.

annotations.keyFindings: A 500 metre cap cut outlets near schools by 23 percent over five years; the difference in the decline in student smoking was 1.4 points with an interval including 0.
annotations.notes: The only evaluation of a cap.

annotations.keyFindings: Self-reported current smoking agreed with cotinine (sensitivity 0.87, specificity 0.96); vaping could not be validated.

claims.text: In a state school survey, students at schools with five or more licensed retailers within 800 metres had higher odds of current smoking after adjustment for school socioeconomic status and remoteness.
claims.passage: Students at schools with five or more retailers within 800 metres had higher odds of current smoking than students at schools with none (odds ratio 1.31, 95 percent CI 1.08 to 1.59)
claims.interpretation: An association of about this size is plausible here; it is not evidence that caps work.

claims.text: In three cities, the association between outlet density and youth smoking largely disappeared after adjustment for neighbourhood deprivation.
claims.passage: after adjustment for neighbourhood deprivation it fell to 1.09 (95 percent CI 0.88 to 1.35)
claims.interpretation: Deprivation must be modelled at school and neighbourhood level; the answer may be null.

claims.text: Retailer counts within 800 metres by road network distance best reflected students' routes, and schools with no retailer should be a separate category.
claims.passage: Counts within 800 metres by road network distance best reflected the routes students reported walking between school and home or shops.

claims.text: Students at schools with three or more retailers within 800 metres had higher odds of current vaping in 2023.
claims.passage: students at schools with three or more retailers within 800 metres had higher odds of current vaping (odds ratio 1.22, 95 percent CI 1.03 to 1.45)
claims.interpretation: Vaping deserves its own outcome and model.

synthesis: Seven retrieved records, appraised at abstract level. Two cross-sectional studies found higher odds of smoking or vaping with more retailers near schools after adjustment for school socioeconomic status, but a three-city study found the smoking association largely explained by neighbourhood deprivation, so the evidence conflicts on confounding. An 800 metre road network buffer is the best-supported exposure, with no-retailer schools as their own category. The only evaluation of a cap found fewer outlets but no clear change in smoking. None of this shows that density causes smoking.
gradeRationale: Cross-sectional studies with inconsistent results after deprivation adjustment and one non-randomised policy evaluation; indirect for a causal policy question.
summary: Seven retrieved records appraised; four claims recorded, two of them in conflict; overall certainty low.
